text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: *pant, haah, haah*! ...Gh...!
choice_data_list:
Let's pick up the speed even more next 
time!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! Urgh...!

In preparation for the upcoming Classic 
campaign, the days of intensive training 
continuedâ

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I'm completely wiped out today 
too...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(The target time they set for me... Back 
then, I thought I'd be fine as long as I 
gave it my all, but—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Reaching my goal feels... further away 
than I thought. Timing-wise, things might 
be on track, but still... it's just so 
frustrating.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I want to catch up quickly, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre, whose debut race sent shockwaves 
through the crowd with a presence far 
beyond that of a newcomer!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Taah!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Displaying her natural, powerful running 
style in the race without holding back, 
she effortlessly seized 1st place—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "Your dream for the Twinkle Series"?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If it is Orfevre-san, I do not think 
capturing the Classic Triple Crown is 
merely a dream!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...... Boring.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What about the others? Are they just the 
same? Saying "What do I want to win?" or 
"What title do I want?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —A waste of time. Bring down the curtain.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I-I am truly sorry! However, um... could 
you at least tell me your true 
intentions!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ............ Dost thou not understand?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"‘It’s not a dream’? —As if it could 
possibly be a dream."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Her demeanor, so brimming with confidence 
it earned her the moniker of 'Tyrant', has 
sparked an enormous sensation!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Truly the presence of a leading star of 
the era! Next year's Classic campaign is 
going to be quite a thrill!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(All this hype for just a debut race...? 
Man, she really is something else.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Even though I'm still... struggling in a 
place like this.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...I actually came.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Still, it's night after all... It'd bug 
people if I shouted, right?)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(The breeze feels nice. I'll just look at 
the stars and head home...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(............ Ugh... I hate moping around 
like this.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Like this, will I ever truly be able 
to surpass that person?)
(Dadadadada...!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Phew... My, I didn't expect someone 
else to already be here at this hour."

The one dashing up to the high platform 
was the unyielding, merit-driven 
Umamusume, Gentildonna.

Despite not having debuted yet, she 
possesses the kind of talent that has 
already drawn the attention of countless 
insiders.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Gentile-san. Um, excuse me. If 
you're going to train here, I'll move out 
of your way.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Pay it no mind. I will return shortly—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Gen... til...!

And chasing after her, running up the hill 
completely out of breath, was—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

Just like Gentildonna, Verxina was 
awaiting her debut. She was the eldest 
daughter of a prestigious family, a 
spirited Umamusume expected to show 
exceptional talent.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... You look to be in quite a bit of 
pain.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, fufu! Oh my! If you have the leeway 
to look back, then your own—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "...*Cough*! ...*Hack, hack*!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Please have a seat and drink 
some water.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My, welcome back.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Well then, I'll be going ahead.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: V-Verxina-san...! Are you okay...?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
There are drinks over that way. I'll go 
grab some, so—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...No, that won't be necessary. It would 
only make me lose sight of my goal.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Pardon me!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...They left. Even though I hadn't even 
caught my breath yet.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (Wait, but—)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm running straight and true...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ......Amazing. ...Just amazing...!
A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: U-Um. Verxina-san.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Shion-san! I'm so sorry about the other 
day. Even though you were looking out for 
me, I brushed you off...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No, more importantly, if you'd like, um... 
How about one? —Apple juice, that is.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, did the me back then... 'strike a 
chord' with you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the sentiment, but back then, 
I don't think I was in any state to be... 
praised like that.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Just when I thought I had caught up 
completely out of breath, I was 
immediately left in the dust again.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No! The way you hung in there and fought 
back was seriously so cool.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It felt like I got a little push on the 
back, or maybe it just made me feel like 
giving it my all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...It's also because it happened right 
when I was feeling a bit faint-hearted 
myself, though.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
So…… I wondered how she could stay so 
strong.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“—In the upcoming Twinkle Series, the most 
troublesome obstacle will be Gentildonna— 
that lady herself.”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why we must be thorough 
starting right now. Keep an eye on them, 
test our strength, and make up for what's 
lacking."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I am preparing. So that no matter how 
powerful she becomes, I will be able to 
brush her aside.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Because the one worthy of the Tiara is me.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"The one worthy"――huh. Heheh! Verxina-san 
really is amazing after all...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Heh... Hey, Shion. It's your turn next, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am aware. Both of that 
Tyrant's reputation, and of the way you 
glare at him.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ! Uh, ah, well, that's—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Day after day, from morning till night. 
Straining every fiber of your being in 
training... I had thought you bore a 
striking resemblance to someone I once 
knew.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I... I am also quite intrigued by your 
story.

After that day, I started seeing her 
talking with Verxina quite often.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Verxina-san.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Is it break time now? Mind if I step out 
for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to thank you for teaching me 
those stretches the other day."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

It seems that as fellow pursuers of the 
strong, they hit it off quite well—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... You're right. In the featured new 
Umamusume section, and the rising 
potential Umamusume section, respectively! 
Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
F-Fufu...! Yes, quite... Early or late, 
it's a trivial—a completely trivial 
difference! I must not let my composure be 
shaken...!

Every time I caught sight of them, they 
seemed to be growing closer.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Gentile ordered an extra-large 
portion, and then looked right at me as if 
asking, "Well, what are you going to 
do?"...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"So you're getting the Super Mega-Sized 
DX!? Whoa... That's the spirit, as 
expected! Oh, I know! I'll get the same—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm gonna give it my all today! 
Looking forward to working with you!
choice_data_list: You're fully fired up, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I heard Verxina's been breaking 
all her personal bests left and right, so 
I can't afford to lose either.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
For now, one lap—no, two laps! I'm off to 
warm up!

Win Variation dashes vigorously across the 
grounds. Glancing down at the split times 
sent to my tablet—

Her times, which had only been inching 
forward recently, had suddenly made a 
massive leap toward the target time.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaah...!! More and more, ...even more! 
I can do it too!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely going to catch up to 
herー!!

...Ever since she started becoming friends 
with Verxina, Win Variation's 
concentration has improved. This change is 
surely thanks to her influence as well.
choice_data_list:
(I'm glad there's someone I can share my 
worries with)

text_block_list.text:
I felt truly grateful for the presence of 
a friend who understood me.
